title: Strong Artin / Komorebi–Langlands audit through v0.25
review_type: self-review of mathematical applications plus fresh machine replay; not an independent human/third-party referee audit
primary_verdict: incomplete, with the smallest missing implication
verdict_scope: The proposed end-to-end Strong Artin deduction, not the correctness of every individual conditional algebra theorem.

additional_ancestor_replay.note: The original partial manifest summary field passed_modules is stale after outer interruption. This audit counts its 30 persisted module_results, not that summary field.

not_claimed: New unconditional Strong Artin or relative arithmetic automorphy theorem
Universal novelty of the algebraic synthesis
Percentage completion of an open conjecture

exact_negative_examples.arithmetic: exact integers modulo 3,4,5,7,8; no floating point
exact_negative_examples.domain: explicit finite examples only; not counterexamples to Strong Artin or correctly stated project theorems

augmented_equation.refutes: augmented solution automatically descends with auxiliary variables zero

submodule_divisibility.refutes: ambient pi-divisibility automatically equals intrinsic pi-divisibility

moving_syzygy.refutes: a residual/frozen syzygy annihilates every integral nonlinear error

determinant_selector.qualification: the lower local restriction is reducible; does not refute the irreducible-restriction theorem

finite_cyclic_normalization.conclusion: full H1 cannot be identified with a one-dimensional line in this rank-two example

nonzero_functionals.refutes: nonzero functionals have the same nonvanishing set without a 1-dimensional or explicit compatibility assumption

cotangent_base_change.conclusion: kernel/base-change identification needs an actual derived comparison; tensoring a kernel can destroy its inclusion

findings.finding: Auxiliary augmentation does not imply descent to original equations
findings.status: Shortcut refuted by an exact example; latest v0.25 boundary correctly excludes it
findings.action: Prove factorization through the auxiliary-zero quotient, genuine level descent, or a separate original-equation lifting theorem.

findings.finding: Bare H1Cotangent is not automatically the arithmetic obstruction or dual Selmer space
findings.status: Comparison remains an assumed Datum; latest boundary corrects earlier overbroad wording
findings.action: Specify the actual deformation functor, coefficient ideal, derived cotangent/Selmer complex, base change, duality and cohomological degrees.

findings.finding: Absolutely irreducible prime-to-p finite image forces p not dividing rank
findings.status: Elementary averaging/Schur proof supplied in this audit; not newly Lean-formalized
findings.action: Do not count this specialization as coverage of the p-dividing-rank sector; identify an actual difficult representation covered by the hypotheses.

findings.finding: One-dimensional normalization does not identify a general full local H1 pairing
findings.status: Current-ancestry source assumes its entire compared H1 is one-dimensional; rank-two norm-zero example has dimension two
findings.action: Construct the correct unramified subspace or local quotient line and prove compatibility, not merely abstract nondegeneracy.

findings.finding: Residual collapse proves uniqueness/comparison, not residual automorphic occurrence
findings.action: Keep Galois residual uniqueness separate from a nonzero determinant-bearing automorphic complex.

findings.finding: Determinant selection inside a torsor does not prove membership or attachment
findings.status: Local reducible-restriction example has equal determinants and cube data without a scalar twist
findings.action: State irreducibility/membership hypotheses explicitly; do not label all p-not-dividing-rank attachment steps solved.

findings.finding: Residual syzygies do not give exact moving identities or correction exactness
findings.status: v0.24 negatives and v0.25 assumptions correctly address this boundary
findings.action: Construct B(x)F(x)=0 and prove image(Jbar)=kernel(Bbar) for the actual problem; compatibility alone is insufficient.

findings.finding: Same version labels denote multiple unmerged branches
findings.status: 741 declarations in v0.25 ancestry versus 960 in all-branch union
findings.action: Identify checkpoints by branch title and full SHA-256; do not count the union as a single compiled release.

findings.finding: A complete whole-ancestry fresh replay was not obtained
findings.status: v0.25 direct closure PASS; 30 additional ancestor modules PASS; broader run INCOMPLETE after two interrupted wrappers
findings.action: Preserve module-level evidence and rerun outstanding modules before declaring the whole ancestry freshly checked.

findings.finding: Minimal scalar labels need not equal the number of arithmetic primes
findings.status: Abstract finite selection is valid; primes/local components and changing arithmetic conditions are additional inputs
findings.action: Distinguish labels, scalar functionals, places, local tangent dimensions and arithmetic auxiliary sets.

findings.finding: A quotient by the scalar coefficient module is not automatically quotienting H1 by one global cyclic class
findings.action: Use the long exact sequence or the actual fixed-restriction Selmer complex, including the connecting morphism.

source_count_qualification: Counts are source theorem/lemma declaration occurrences after exact file-byte deduplication, not independent discoveries or a Lean-environment declaration export.
